resources.string: Export media and metadata to ES-DE
After each download, writes the cover, screenshot, logo, clip and gamelist.xml entry, so ES-DE shows the game without scraping. Files already there are never replaced.
Not found: no ES-DE/settings/es_settings.xml on this device
All files access is needed to reach ES-DE\'s folder
ES-DE/ at the root of the internal memory or of an SD card
Opens Android\'s settings for this app
ES-DE\'s media folder (%1$s) cannot be written by this app: only gamelist.xml is exported
ES-DE keeps its gamelists in the ROM folders (legacy option): gamelist.xml is not written
ES-DE\'s marquee: the game\'s title as a transparent image
Name, description, date, developer, genre, players and rating in gamelist.xml. Existing entries only get the fields they lack.
Export for games already on the device
Writes what is missing for every game in the ROM folders

Close ES-DE first (quit it from its menu). ES-DE keeps its own copy of the games it already lists and may write it back over these entries if it is running. Media and entries already present are kept. Restart ES-DE afterwards to see the result.
